cases.sentence: «Не бойся, Авраам, я твой щит, ___ твоя будет весьма велика».
cases.translation: Don't be afraid, Abram, I am your shield, your reward will be very great.
cases.explain: Награда is the subject of будет весьма велика, so it stands in the nominative.

cases.translation: My estate will be inherited by Eliezer of Damascus.
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ты отойдешь к ___ своим в мире и будешь погребен в глубокой старости.
cases.translation: You will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a good old age.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Я отдаю твоим потомкам эту ___, от Египетской реки до Великой реки Ефрат.
cases.translation: I give this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river Euphrates.
cases.explain: The transitive verb отдаю takes its direct object, земля, in the accusative.

cases.sentence: И тогда они выйдут оттуда с большим ___.
cases.translation: And then they will come out from there with great wealth.
cases.explain: The preposition с indicating accompaniment governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: В четвертом ___ твои потомки вернутся сюда, потому что грех Амореев еще не достиг полной меры.
cases.translation: In the fourth generation your descendants will come back here, because the sin of the Amorites has not yet reached its full measure.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating a point in time takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: «Не бойся, Авраам, я твой щит, награда твоя будет весьма велика».
reading.question: What did the Lord call himself to Abram?
options: His shield and very great reward
reading.correct: His shield and very great reward
reading.explain: The Lord says 'я твой щит, награда твоя будет весьма велика' (I am your shield, your reward will be very great).

reading.ru: Авраам поверил Господу, и он вменил ему это в праведность.
reading.question: What happened when Abram believed the Lord?
options: It was credited to him as righteousness
reading.correct: It was credited to him as righteousness
reading.explain: The text says the Lord 'вменил ему это в праведность' (credited it to him as righteousness).

reading.ru: «Приведи мне трехлетнюю телицу, трехлетнюю козу и трехлетнего барана, а также принеси горлицу и молодого голубя».
reading.question: What animals did the Lord tell Abram to bring?
options: A heifer, a goat, a ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon
reading.correct: A heifer, a goat, a ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon
reading.explain: The Lord lists exactly these animals: a three-year heifer, goat, and ram, plus a turtledove and a young pigeon.

reading.ru: «Знай же, что твои потомки будут странниками в чужой земле, они будут обращены в рабство и будут угнетаемы четыреста лет, но я накажу народ, поработивший их».
reading.question: How many years would Abram's descendants be enslaved?
reading.explain: The text says his descendants 'будут угнетаемы четыреста лет' (will be oppressed for four hundred years).
